title: Top Streaming Sticks & Boxes for Any TV (2026)
summary: The top streaming sticks and boxes for any TV in 2026 are led by Roku’s Ultra and Streaming Stick 4K, followed by Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max, Apple TV 4K, and Google TV Streamer.
method: Selected products that appear in at least two of the cited sources (CNET, Tom’s Guide, Yahoo Tech, Wired). Ranked by how often they were highlighted and by the breadth of features mentioned.
assumptions: Prices are only included when a source explicitly states them; otherwise the price field is null.

products.name: Roku Ultra
why: The Roku Ultra is described as the top pick for 2026, offering an intuitive interface and comprehensive support for 4K, HDR10+, Dolby Vision, and Dolby Atmos.
It includes a rechargeable remote, integrated live TV guide, and Apple AirPlay support, making it a versatile choice for most users.
products.best_for: Users who want a feature‑rich, easy‑to‑use streaming box with full 4K HDR support.
products.skip_if: Your TV already supports all the latest streaming apps and you prefer a minimalistic stick.

products.name: Roku Streaming Stick 4K
why: Offers robust app and Dolby Vision support with a simple interface.
It is highlighted as the best stick for HDR content in CNET’s 2026 roundup.
products.best_for: Viewers who want high‑quality HDR streaming in a compact stick.
products.skip_if: You need Dolby Atmos or advanced gaming features.

products.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max (2023)
products.badge: Best for Gamers and Power Users
why: Fast loading times and the latest playback standards are noted in CNET’s review.
It is positioned as the best option for gamers and power users.
cons: Only slightly improved from previous model
No mention of Dolby Atmos support in source 0
products.best_for: Gamers and power users who want fast performance and Alexa integration.
products.skip_if: You prefer a simpler interface or are on a tight budget.

products.name: Apple TV 4K (2022)
why: CNET notes its speedy performance and robust app support, and Tom’s Guide lists it as the best for Apple users.
It integrates well with other Apple services.
products.best_for: Apple ecosystem users who want seamless integration with iOS and macOS.
products.skip_if: You are not an Apple user or are looking for a cheaper option.

products.name: Google TV Streamer
why: Tom’s Guide and CNET both highlight its powerful gaming capabilities and broad app support.
It offers excellent smart home integration.
products.best_for: Android users who want a powerful, feature‑rich streaming experience.
products.skip_if: You prefer a simpler interface or are on a tight budget.
